branch_protection.conclusion: Branch API reports protected=true, but no required status-check contexts are configured in the returned metadata. Full review/approval/force-push settings remain unknown.

risks: Untrusted workflow-dispatch input is interpolated directly into a shell command, creating command-injection risk.
Credential is supplied through workflow input rather than a dedicated secret-management channel.
The declared GITHUB_TOKEN permission does not grant the secret mutation and workflow-dispatch capabilities the workflow appears to require.
The subsequent deployment dispatch would use the deployment workflow's default confirmation input unless explicitly supplied; the claimed verification path is not established.

changes: Replaced with a diagnostic explicitly stating ROTATION_NOT_PERFORMED.
Added two regression tests and registered them in CI.

workflow_inventory.residual_manual_writer_notes: These workflows are workflow_dispatch-only in the inspected versions but declare contents:write and commit/push to main without a separate confirm_external_change input. None was dispatched. They require a separate review and either artifact-only output or explicit approval gating.
workflow_inventory.scheduled_issue_mutation_notes: These paths use issue/PR write permissions and scheduled triggers. They do not represent direct repository-main file writes in the inspected workflow bodies, but they do mutate GitHub issue/PR state and require a separate authorization/scope review.
workflow_inventory.guarded_external_action_notes: Inspected versions require confirm_external_change=YES before the external-action job proceeds. No such workflow was dispatched.

pr1397.scope_note: Quarantines selected scheduled main writers and changes selected workflows to artifact/read-only paths; does not address the manual writer list above or all 77 workflows.
